Based on the provided procurement records for Solicitation `SOL-2026-DATA-02`, here are the details regarding Addendum 0001 and the Medallion architecture layers:

**1. Modification to Streaming Ingestion Latency SLA (DATA-SLA-3.1)**
* **Base Requirement:** In the base RFP, end-to-end streaming ingestion latency from Cloud Pub/Sub through Apache Beam / Dataflow into BigQuery Silver tables was required not to exceed 30 seconds (p99) (`01_RFP_Data_Platform.pdf`, p. 1).
* **Addendum 0001 Override:** To support real-time fraud detection, Addendum 0001 supersedes Clause `DATA-SLA-3.1` and reduces the maximum end-to-end `Pub/Sub -> Dataflow -> BigQuery Silver` streaming latency from 30 seconds down to **5 seconds (p99 <= 5.0 seconds)** using BigQuery Storage Write API committed streams (`05_Amendments_and_Addenda.pdf`, p. 1).

**2. Modification to Annual Cost for 6,000 TB of Active Lakehouse Storage (CLIN-1004)**
* **Base Pricing:** In the initial pricing schedule, `CLIN-1004` (Active Lakehouse Storage) for a monthly quantity of 6,000 TB had a base unit rate of $20.00/TB/mo, resulting in an annual total of **$1,440,000** (`03_Pricing_and_Volume_Tiers.pdf`, p. 1).
* **Addendum 0001 Override:** Addendum 0001 supersedes `CLIN-1004` by introducing a **15% volume discount** for Active Lakehouse Storage exceeding 5 Petabytes (5,000 TB) (`05_Amendments_and_Addenda.pdf`, p. 1). This reduces the effective rate from $20.00/TB/mo to **$17.00/TB/mo**, lowering the annual total for 6,000 TB from $1,440,000 down to **$1,224,000** (`05_Amendments_and_Addenda.pdf`, p. 1).

**3. The Three Medallion Storage Layers**
According to Architecture Specification `ARCH-MEDALLION-02` and its accompanying vector diagram (`SOL-2026-DATA-02 Pub/Sub -> Dataflow -> BigQuery Medallion Architecture`), the three Medallion storage layers in BigQuery + BigLake Iceberg are (`02_Architecture_Requirements.pdf`, p. 1):
1. **Bronze Layer (`BigQuery Bronze (Raw)`):** Raw append-only change-data-capture (CDC) tables (`02_Architecture_Requirements.pdf`, p. 1).
2. **Silver Layer (`BigQuery Silver (Curated)`):** Deduplicated, schema-enforced enterprise entity tables (`02_Architecture_Requirements.pdf`, p. 1).
3. **Gold Layer (`BigQuery Gold (Governed)`):** Governed semantic marts and Vertex AI Feature Store embeddings (`02_Architecture_Requirements.pdf`, p. 1).

**1. Modification to Streaming Ingestion Latency SLA (DATA-SLA-3.1)**
* **Base Requirement:** In the base RFP, end-to-end streaming ingestion latency from Cloud Pub/Sub through Apache Beam / Dataflow into BigQuery Silver tables was required not to exceed 30 seconds (p99) (`01_RFP_Data_Platform.pdf`, p. 1).
* **Addendum 0001 Override:** To support real-time fraud detection, Addendum 0001 supersedes Clause `DATA-SLA-3.1` and reduces the maximum end-to-end `Pub/Sub -> Dataflow -> BigQuery Silver` streaming latency from 30 seconds down to **5 seconds (p99 <= 5.0 seconds)** using BigQuery Storage Write API committed streams (`05_Amendments_and_Addenda.pdf`, p. 1).

**2. Modification to Annual Cost for 6,000 TB of Active Lakehouse Storage (CLIN-1004)**
* **Base Pricing:** In the initial pricing schedule, `CLIN-1004` (Active Lakehouse Storage) for a monthly quantity of 6,000 TB had a base unit rate of $20.00/TB/mo, resulting in an annual total of **$1,440,000** (`03_Pricing_and_Volume_Tiers.pdf`, p. 1).
* **Addendum 0001 Override:** Addendum 0001 supersedes `CLIN-1004` by introducing a **15% volume discount** for Active Lakehouse Storage exceeding 5 Petabytes (5,000 TB) (`05_Amendments_and_Addenda.pdf`, p. 1). This reduces the effective rate from $20.00/TB/mo to **$17.00/TB/mo**, lowering the annual total for 6,000 TB from $1,440,000 down to **$1,224,000** (`05_Amendments_and_Addenda.pdf`, p. 1).

**3. The Three Medallion Storage Layers**
According to Architecture Specification `ARCH-MEDALLION-02` and its accompanying vector diagram (`SOL-2026-DATA-02 Pub/Sub -> Dataflow -> BigQuery Medallion Architecture`), the three Medallion storage layers in BigQuery + BigLake Iceberg are (`02_Architecture_Requirements.pdf`, p. 1):
1. **Bronze Layer (`BigQuery Bronze (Raw)`):** Raw append-only change-data-capture (CDC) tables (`02_Architecture_Requirements.pdf`, p. 1).
2. **Silver Layer (`BigQuery Silver (Curated)`):** Deduplicated, schema-enforced enterprise entity tables (`02_Architecture_Requirements.pdf`, p. 1).
3. **Gold Layer (`BigQuery Gold (Governed)`):** Governed semantic marts and Vertex AI Feature Store embeddings (`02_Architecture_Requirements.pdf`, p. 1).

Based on the provided procurement records for Solicitation `SOL-2026-DATA-02`, here are the details regarding Addendum 0001 and the Medallion architecture layers:

**1. Modification to Streaming Ingestion Latency SLA (DATA-SLA-3.1)**
* **Base Requirement:** In the base RFP, end-to-end streaming ingestion latency from Cloud Pub/Sub through Apache Beam / Dataflow into BigQuery Silver tables was required not to exceed 30 seconds (p99) (`01_RFP_Data_Platform.pdf`, p. 1).
* **Addendum 0001 Override:** To support real-time fraud detection, Addendum 0001 supersedes Clause `DATA-SLA-3.1` and reduces the maximum end-to-end `Pub/Sub -> Dataflow -> BigQuery Silver` streaming latency from 30 seconds down to **5 seconds (p99 <= 5.0 seconds)** using BigQuery Storage Write API committed streams (`05_Amendments_and_Addenda.pdf`, p. 1).

**2. Modification to Annual Cost for 6,000 TB of Active Lakehouse Storage (CLIN-1004)**
* **Base Pricing:** In the initial pricing schedule, `CLIN-1004` (Active Lakehouse Storage) for a monthly quantity of 6,000 TB had a base unit rate of $20.00/TB/mo, resulting in an annual total of **$1,440,000** (`03_Pricing_and_Volume_Tiers.pdf`, p. 1).
* **Addendum 0001 Override:** Addendum 0001 supersedes `CLIN-1004` by introducing a **15% volume discount** for Active Lakehouse Storage exceeding 5 Petabytes (5,000 TB) (`05_Amendments_and_Addenda.pdf`, p. 1). This reduces the effective rate from $20.00/TB/mo to **$17.00/TB/mo**, lowering the annual total for 6,000 TB from $1,440,000 down to **$1,224,000** (`05_Amendments_and_Addenda.pdf`, p. 1).

**3. The Three Medallion Storage Layers**
According to Architecture Specification `ARCH-MEDALLION-02` and its accompanying vector diagram (`SOL-2026-DATA-02 Pub/Sub -> Dataflow -> BigQuery Medallion Architecture`), the three Medallion storage layers in BigQuery + BigLake Iceberg are (`02_Architecture_Requirements.pdf`, p. 1):
1. **Bronze Layer (`BigQuery Bronze (Raw)`):** Raw append-only change-data-capture (CDC) tables (`02_Architecture_Requirements.pdf`, p. 1).
2. **Silver Layer (`BigQuery Silver (Curated)`):** Deduplicated, schema-enforced enterprise entity tables (`02_Architecture_Requirements.pdf`, p. 1).
3. **Gold Layer (`BigQuery Gold (Governed)`):** Governed semantic marts and Vertex AI Feature Store embeddings (`02_Architecture_Requirements.pdf`, p. 1).
